description: The whole content of one attachment of a mail message (a patch, a log, a test case), chosen by 1-based index or a filename substring, as listed in get_message/get_thread attachments. Text comes back as text, whatever content type it was sent with (a .patch is ready to read or `git apply`); binary as base64 with encoding=base64. size is the decoded byte count; url downloads the same bytes over HTTP. If your client cuts long tool results, read a large text attachment in pieces with start_line/end_line (at most 2000 lines per call; total_lines and cut say what is left). Cite the message as https://postgr.es/m/<message_id>.

end_line.description: Text attachments only: last line to return (1-based, inclusive), capped at start_line + 1999.

filename.description: Substring to match against attachment filenames

inbox.description: Mailing list name, e.g. pgsql-general. Defaults to pgsql-hackers when omitted. Aliases: list, inbox_name.

message_id.description: Message-ID (with or without angle brackets), or a message URL (postgr.es/m/..., postgresql.org/message-id/..., pg.ddx.io/m/...)

start_line.description: Text attachments only: first line to return (1-based). Omit both start_line and end_line for the whole attachment.

name: get_attachment
